notes: OPERATOR-EDITABLE. Read by hooks/cycle_telemetry.py:load_pricing() -- never
hardcoded in code. Rates are USD per 1,000,000 tokens, broken out by the
same four buckets the spend ledger records: input, output, cache_read,
cache_creation (5-minute prompt-cache write). These are illustrative
figures VERIFIED 2026-09-05 against platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing
(cache_read = 0.1x input; cache_creation = 1.25x input, the 5-minute write).
CORRECTION 2026-09-05: every rate in this file was STALE and was corrected.
opus-4-8 read 15/75, which are the RETIRED Opus 4.1/4.0 rates -- Opus 4.5
through Opus 5 are all 5/25, so this file overstated every opus dollar by
3.0x. sonnet-5 read 3/15; Sonnet 5's launch introductory 2/10 became the
permanent price (the 2026-09-01 rise to 3/15 was cancelled). haiku-4-5 read
0.80/4, which are the RETIRED Haiku 3.5 rates; Haiku 4.5 is 1/5.
THIS IS THE THIRD OF THREE INDEPENDENT PRICING TABLES in this runtime
(the others: hooks/cycle_budget.py PRICING_USD_PER_MTOK, coarse by family;
usage-dashboard/ccdash/pricing.py, keyed by exact model id and the
AUTHORITATIVE fine instrument -- it alone was correct). All three drifting
independently with no parity check is tracked as ledger row AA-0095.
When they disagree, ccdash wins and the other two are corrected to match.
A model string with no entry here is left UNPRICED on purpose
(cycle_telemetry.price_tokens returns null) -- the library never guesses
a price for a model it doesn't have data for. Internal/dev/aliased model
strings (e.g. a bare 'opus', or a variant tag like a long-context suffix)
are deliberately omitted rather than assumed equivalent to a base model.
